We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template from make_1_lvl1-template_search-1 to the given molecule. We have the answer from that step: mapped_rxn: 'Cc1ccccc1.Br>>Cc1ccccc1Br', template_id 1914384. So template is a reaction: Cc1ccccc1.Br>>Cc1ccccc1Br (i.e., bromination of toluene? Actually forward: Cc1ccccc1.Br -> Cc1ccccc1Br (bromination of toluene). Retrosynthetic template would break C-Br bond to give toluene and Br? So applying retrosynthetic template to target molecule (the given initial_molecule) will produce precursors. Need to apply template 1914384 to the initial molecule.

We need to get the SMILES of initial molecule. Provided as atom-mapped SMILES with atom map numbers. We need to convert to normal SMILES (remove mapping). The string: [CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]

We need to produce a SMILES without mapping and with appropriate aromatic etc. Let's try to interpret: [CH2:1]=[C:2] ( [c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1 ) [C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]

So it's a bicyclic? Actually C@@H:9 attached to a cyclobutane? Let's try to generate SMILES: CH2= C( aromatic phenyl ) C@@H1CH2CH2CH2C@@1(OH) C(F)(F)F . So overall: CH2=C(c1ccccc1)C1CC C C1(OH)C(F)(F)F with stereochemistry. So SMILES maybe: C= C(c1ccccc1)C1CC C C1(O)C(F)(F)F . Need correct: C= C(c1ccccc1)C1CC C C1(O)C(F)(F)F . The cyclobutane? Actually C@@H1[CH2][CH2][CH2][C@@]1: that's a cyclobutane with two stereocenters? That's a cyclobutane ring: C1-CH2-CH2-CH2-C1 (so 4-member). So SMILES: C= C(c1ccccc1)C1CC C C1(O)C(F)(F)F . Write as: C= C(c1ccccc1)C1CC C C1(O)C(F)(F)F . Need proper: C= C(c1ccccc1)C1CC C C1(O)C(F)(F)F . Let's produce: C= C(c1ccccc1)C1CC C C1(O)C(F)(F)F . Actually need no spaces: C=C(c1ccccc1)C1CCC(C1)O? Wait.

Better to use RDKit but can't. However applying template may not need exact SMILES; tool apply_template expects SMILES string. We can try to use the mapped SMILES directly? Probably need unmapped.

We could try to call apply_template with the given mapped SMILES? Might work if tool strips mapping. Let's attempt.
